title: SEC4: starttls_requested return needs caller comment
description: In lifecycle.rs run_command_loop (~line 435-436), the code sets ctx.starttls_requested = true then returns from the loop with the comment 'caller performs TLS handshake'. However, the mechanism is non-obvious: a bare return from a loop normally signals an error or disconnect exit; here it is intentional cooperative signaling to run_plain_session, which checks the flag after the loop. A reader landing on this return for the first time has to trace back to run_plain_session to understand the design. The comment at the return site should also reference the post-return check location (i.e. 'returns to run_plain_session which performs the TLS handshake') so the intent is clear in place.
